hypothesis: Within the unchanged V18 retained CL direction, the first same-session transition where completed CL and matched MCL volume-weighted close-location flow both move from adverse/nonfinancing to financing may identify dominant-book auction reacquisition. Price-body agreement labels acceptance; flow agreement despite at least one nonconfirming body labels absorption. Session-direction consumption prevents churn without a quota.

flow_owner.bar: completed five-minute CL and matched-MCL OHLCV only
flow_owner.definition: volume multiplied by (2*close-high-low)/(high-low), zero for a zero-range bar
flow_owner.meaning: bounded close-location flow proxy; never represented as bid-ask classified order-flow delta
flow_owner.direction: unchanged exact V18 retained CL trend state
flow_owner.trigger: previous completed CL and MCL directional flow both <=0; current completed directional flow both >0
flow_owner.natural_rearm: new session or genuine retained-direction flip only

branches.price_acceptance: both completed CL and MCL candle bodies also move in retained direction
branches.flow_absorption: joint flow reacquires retained direction while at least one completed price body does not

frozen_order: replay exact roll-adjusted completed CL/MCL five-minute bars and exact V18 retained state
compute only bounded signed close-location flow from each completed bar
consume the first exact joint adverse-to-financing transition per session and retained direction
classify price acceptance versus flow absorption and project the next executable MCL open
count discovery and validation independently; open no trade outcome
if_eligible: Preregister one position lifecycle: next-open MCL entry; next-open exit after joint directional flow becomes adverse or retained state flips; hard session/contract/gap flat; discovery must pass before validation opens. V18-primary composition is downstream only if standalone ownership is positive and nonoverlapping.
prohibitions: no flow magnitude, lookback, smoothing, percentile, volume threshold, body threshold, lane, time, maturity, ATR, news, stop, target, timeout, cooldown, or quota neighbor
no reuse of opening-drive close-location quartiles, fixed anchors, VWAP reclaim, term structure, RB/HO, or V18 rejection add-ons
no trade outcome, validation PnL, order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
downstream_hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract history
unseen runtime parity and prospective signal tape
native MCL spread, liquidity, margin, commission, roll, preview, restart, reconciliation, shared-capital, and graduation proof
